title: Frontend, backend, database in one file
summary: The notes app's web and api are here, with no way to start them. Write the compose.yaml for all three parts, database included.

tasks.title: `web`, `api` and `db` are all running, started by Compose from this folder
tasks.hint: Three services under `services:`. `web` and `api` have `build: ./web` and `build: ./api`; `db` has `image: postgres:17-alpine`. Then `docker compose up -d --build`. `docker compose ps -a` shows which one stopped, `docker compose logs <service>` says why.

tasks.title: `http://localhost:3501` opens with no red error
tasks.hint: Read the red message. "web can't reach the api": check `API_URL` and that the service is called `api`. "api can't reach the database": `DB_HOST` must be the service name `db`, and the user, password and database name must match on both sides.

tasks.title: You saved a note, and it shows in the list
tasks.hint: Open http://localhost:3501, write a note, press Save.

tasks.title: `db` keeps its data in a named volume
tasks.hint: Under `db`: `volumes:` `- data:/var/lib/postgresql/data`, and at the bottom of the file `volumes:` `data:`. Then `docker compose up -d`.
